goal: Verify that a user can successfully register as a Site Host, create a standard memo, and create a second memo that includes a hashtag tag.

findings.instruction: In the same text area, type 'Meeting notes for #team-sync' and click the 'Save' button again.
findings.title: Second memo with hashtag was not created due to incorrect element targeting
findings.description: The test step intended to type 'Meeting notes for #team-sync' into the text input area, but the automation script incorrectly targeted a button element instead of the input field. As a result, the text was never entered, and the second memo was not created. This prevents verification of hashtag rendering and tag sidebar updates.
findings.evidence: The error log shows 'Element is not an <input>, <textarea>, <select> or [contenteditable]' when attempting to fill a button. The AFTER screenshot shows no new memo in the feed, and the text input area remains empty with placeholder 'Any thoughts...'.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the main dashboard after logging in.
Attempt to type 'Meeting notes for #team-sync' into the text area using an incorrect selector that targets a button instead of the input field.
Observe that the text is not entered and no new memo appears in the feed.
